decisions.reason: The gas tariff comparison sits close to the core offer, runs on the same daily updated market data and has its own page, so keeping it costs little and adds value to the platform.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is core-adjacent and prominently presented, and it serves steady demand from suppliers needing tariff calculations.

The energy tariff calculator line has low website prominence and some overlap with C, but its shared data base makes it cheap to keep, so it is more likely to be folded into the platform than withdrawn.
The site-specific tariff comparison models build on the same databases and the established offer, so maintaining them is inexpensive even though they are only mentioned on the website.
